_purpose: The single source for the background colour both browser gates measure against. Duplicating this box was a real finding: two gates asking 'did the package draw anything?' must ask it in the same units, and a colour changed in one example and not the other silently turns one of them into a different question. Read by scripts/verify-tarball.mjs (the tarball gate, against examples/quickstart) and examples/e2e/from-docs.spec.ts (the documentation gate, against examples/from-docs). Both gates also assert that their scene's source actually declares `hex` — a shared constant nobody checks against the source is just a third place to be wrong.
_box: Upper bounds, per channel, generously above rgb above: a pixel at or below all three is background, anything else is something the scene drew on top. The margin absorbs PNG compression and antialiasing at the tile edges.
